spec_doc: docs/specs/gig-runs-once.red-spec.json — engine half of the two-repo fix; the store half (coltrane_drain_renew / coltrane_drain_release, attempts/max_attempts, terminal-status guard on the header upsert, lease clearing on terminal writes, manifest merge) lands in eir-labs/coltrane-ui branch work/gig-runs-once and deploys first. CONTRACT SURFACE the laws pin — src/lease.ts: export const HOSTED_LEASE_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000; export const DRAIN_LEASE_ROUTES = { renew: '/rest/v1/rpc/coltrane_drain_renew', release: '/rest/v1/rpc/coltrane_drain_release' }; renew: POST ${COLTRANE_DRAIN_URL}${DRAIN_LEASE_ROUTES.renew} body {p_instance, p_gig_id}, Bearer drain key, X-Coltrane-Instance; 200 -> new lease_until; 403 / 42501 -> lease lost; release: POST ${COLTRANE_DRAIN_URL}${DRAIN_LEASE_ROUTES.release} body {p_instance, p_gig_id, p_reason, p_terminal} -> boolean; WorkOnceDeps.scheduleHeartbeat: (intervalMs: number, beat: () => Promise<unknown>) => () => void; default arms an unref'd setInterval; interval = HOSTED_LEASE_MS / 3; WorkOnceResult.acknowledged: boolean on a claimed result: true iff the store acknowledged the terminal header; terminal header attempts: 3; header status: 'running' is a new GigHeaderRecord status, sent awaited before the first chair with the run's genome_hash; manifest.cold_run_reason: string on a header written by a run that went cold because a resume was refused.
validation_criteria: every contract invariant E1-E8 has a red law that drives production code and names its plant
the drain-service lease RPC routes live in ONE constant (DRAIN_LEASE_ROUTES, src/lease.ts)
no law sleeps on a real clock for the heartbeat: WorkOnceDeps.scheduleHeartbeat is the injected clock
the rest of the suite stays green and tsc --noEmit is clean

implementer obligation: tests/gig_header_drain.test.ts 'a chair failure produces one failed-header POST' picks the FIRST coltrane_gigs POST; if the 'running' header is written from runGig, that law must select by status

implementer obligation: tests/drain_worker.test.ts 'refuses a gig the store leased without minting' matches /minted no credential/; the release-first path may keep that wording but should drop 'the row stays leased'
implementer obligation: the local queue's I14/O4 laws re-complete a DONE gig by its holder; the new holder check must keep admitting the holder on a row already in done/

testing_method: vitest, example-based and behavioural: every engine law drives workOnce (or runCli / openLocalQueue) through a stubbed global fetch that plays both hosts — the org store (ctx.baseUrl RPCs) and the drain service (COLTRANE_DRAIN_URL: header, outputs, storage, renew, release) — statefully, so a re-claim reads what the first worker's acknowledged writes left behind. The heartbeat's clock is injected (WorkOnceDeps.scheduleHeartbeat) and fired from inside the chair invocation; acknowledgement is observed by holding the store's answer back (a delayed Response) and asserting what had resolved when workOnce returned. E8 moves the lease constant with vi.doMock over src/lease.ts and asserts both derived numbers follow. New symbols are reached by variable specifiers and casts so tsc over tests/ stays clean.
